## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF — Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: +0.80% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY ↑ rising (short-term pickup in fear) and SPY/TLT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -0.31%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling (stocks lagging bonds); XLF (1W: -2.39% | 1M: -4.07%) BELOW TREND further supports guarded stance.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress flickering: Credit Spread (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.24%) CORRECTION ↑ rising (month view). Fear edging up: VXX (1W: +0.80% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY ↑ rising. Safe-haven demand strong: GLD (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +12.19%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tight: UUP (Dollar) (1W: -1.90% | 1M: -0.11%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION → flat; Yield Curve (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +0.30%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals pockets lead: XME (1W: +6.25% | 1M: +22.66%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +3.32% | 1M: +11.26%) ABOVE TREND. Tech weak: XLK (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND; Financials weak: XLF (1W: -2.39% | 1M: -4.07%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
EM strength vs US: EEM (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND while SPY (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.64%) CORRECTION — EM outperforming on the month. China FXI (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +2.10%) CORRECTION; Europe outperformance in ratios supports regional divergence.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Cooling: IBIT (1W: -6.11% | 1M: +1.22%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -0.97%) BELOW TREND show reduced froth; IWM (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +4.43%) CORRECTION indicates selective small-cap resilience.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Safe-haven and base metals strong: SLV (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +48.73%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +12.19%) ABOVE TREND. Industrial signals mixed: CPER (1W: -0.68% | 1M: +8.27%) CORRECTION.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy and nat-gas leadership: XLE (1W: +3.32% | 1M: +11.26%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +7.31%) ABOVE TREND, UNG (1W: +35.63% | 1M: +17.89%) ABOVE TREND — strong reflation/commodity bid.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: GLD (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +12.19%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +48.73%) ABOVE TREND show clear safe-haven trend. DIVERGENCE: Minor divergence — SPY (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.64%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION mismatch; multiple cyclicals (IWM, CPER, XLI) show 1W/1M splits, monitor for momentum fade.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor defensive and commodity exposure: GLD (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +12.19%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +48.73%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +3.32% | 1M: +11.26%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to broad growth beta where tech and financials are BELOW TREND and volatility is picking up.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +3.32% | 1M: +11.26%) ABOVE TREND and Materials XME (1W: +6.25% | 1M: +22.66%) ABOVE TREND if commodity strength continues. BEARISH: Financials XLF (1W: -2.39% | 1M: -4.07%) BELOW TREND and Tech XLK (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND if risk-off sentiment persists.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +48.73%) ABOVE TREND and NatGas UNG (1W: +35.63% | 1M: +17.89%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper/industrial metals CPER (1W: -0.68% | 1M: +8.27%) CORRECTION if macro demand concerns re-emerge.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~ 20 (complacency threshold). HYG/LQD ~ 0.80 (credit health pivot). XLK/XLF ratio ~ 2.7 (tech vs financials leadership inflection).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF — Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, supported by rising VXX (1W: +0.80% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY and SPY/TLT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -0.31%) BELOW TREND. Commodities and safe-havens showing strength: GLD (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +12.19%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +48.73%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: minor but broadening divergence between equities and bonds (SPY vs TLT) and selective 1W/1M sector splits — monitor tech/financials for further weakness.
